weight_policy.aggregation: Sum the positive weights of passing scientific tests after complete, trusted execution. Equivalent parameter cases divide a fixed behavior budget.
weight_policy.basis: Coupled physical behavior and state evolution carry the main contribution; input rejection and interface compatibility have smaller, separate budgets. Adding parameter cases does not increase a behavior's total budget.
hard_gates: Exact complete collection and setup/call/teardown evidence
Matching JUnit, ledger, exit status and trusted source hashes
No candidate transport crash, local deadline, malformed protocol, verifier timeout or cleanup failure
